ns2:course.label: Off-Campus Horticulture Internship
ns2:course.description: Supervised, off-campus experience in a field directly pertaining to a subject matter in horticulture. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 10 hours. For registration in this course students should contact the Department Undergraduate Program Coordinator. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing, cumulative GPA of 2.0 or above at the time the internship is arranged, and consent of instructor.
